name: Sacrament Of Marriage
overview: Scripture reveals marriage as a divinely ordained union where a man and woman become one flesh, emphasizing companionship and mutual support as God declared it is not good for man to be alone. The Bible highlights the value and blessing of a prudent wife as a gift from the Lord, encouraging husbands to cherish their wives as faithful companions within a covenant relationship. Marriage is portrayed as a sacred bond witnessed by God, calling for faithfulness and honoring the lifelong commitment established at the union.
